name: Bauhaus Grid
tagline: Red, blue and black modules that pop, rotate in waves and swap colour on a cream page.
description: Square design-poster style for events, studios and brand reels. A 4×4 grid of geometric modules (circles, arches, quarters, leaves) pops in from the centre, rotates in staggered waves, swaps colours, then a blue wipe reveals a bouncing lowercase wordmark. Small italic-serif and mono HUD labels frame every scene.

body.usage: Uppercase HUD meta and timecode, 17px, tracking 0.08em

transitions: circle ring scales past the frame to clear it
full-frame blue wipe from the bottom (scaleY 0→1)
textAnimations: per-letter rise with alternating ±14° rotation, back.out
a red dot drops onto the wordmark with bounce.out
letters wobble once in alternating directions
timecode counts frames in the corner

rhythm.notes: Every ~0.8s the grid does one thing: pop, rotate wave, colour swap, rotate back, breathe. Waves use grid staggers from centre, start or end.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Only cream #ece6d6, red #f2542d, blue #2f4bf5 and black #121212 (cream text on blue). Flat fills; no gradients, shadows, outlines or textures.
- Build everything from geometric modules: ~168px squares shaped with border-radius only (circle 50%, arch, quarter-circle, leaf, drop). Lay them on a strict 4×4 grid with 16px gutters, or assemble the subject itself from the same modules.
- Move modules with GSAP grid staggers ({ grid: [4,4], from: "center" | "start" | "end" }) so every move reads as a wave: pop in with back.out(1.8), rotate in 90° steps with power3.inOut.
- Swap red and blue in one beat instead of fading. Something changes about every 0.8s: pop, rotate wave, colour swap, rotate back, breathe.
- Frame every scene like a poster: an Instrument Serif italic label (40px) top-left, JetBrains Mono 500 uppercase meta (17px, tracking 0.08em) and a running frame timecode along the bottom.
- Clear the frame with a ring that scales past the edges (power3.in) or a full-frame blue wipe from the bottom (scaleY 0→1, expo.inOut).
- Titles are Outfit 800 lowercase, ~210px, tracking -0.04em: letters rise one by one with alternating ±14° rotation (back.out), wobble once, and a single red dot drops in with bounce.out as the only accent. Pair them with one short factual line.
- Avoid photos, realistic illustration, extra colours and soft easing on colour changes.
example: The preview shows a 4×4 grid of red, blue and black shapes popping, rotating in waves and swapping colours, then a blue wipe to a bouncing lowercase wordmark with open-studio dates. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
